finalText:
Found 11 straggler files still calling `db.query` and moved every call over to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

- `cohort.js`, `returnService.js`, `shipment.js`, `refund.js`, `couponService.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, `teamService.js`, `session.js`

Left `cache.query` and `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone — the cache calls aren't the database, and the vendor file gets overwritten on every upgrade anyway. The repo's own verify script confirms it: `node verify.js` passed clean.
